children: Dell Technologies
heads into fiscal second-quarter earnings with unusually high expectations after a massive 2026 rally, as options traders price in an
11.4% move

following Tuesday's report. With revenue expected to surge more than 50% and AI-server demand increasingly central to the growth story, Dell may need more than another earnings beat to justify a stock that has already climbed roughly
266% year to date

Dell sells PCs, servers, storage systems and enterprise infrastructure, generating revenue from both consumer hardware and large corporate and data-center customers. Its infrastructure business has taken on greater importance as companies and cloud providers spend heavily on servers designed for artificial-intelligence workloads.
Wall Street expects Dell to report adjusted earnings of
$4.91 per share
, more than double the
earned a year earlier. Revenue is projected to jump
50.9% year over year to $44.93 billion
Dell has beaten earnings expectations in
seven of its past eight quarters
, raising expectations heading into the September 1 report.
The options market is signaling that investors expect a much bigger reaction than usual. Contracts expiring September 4 imply a roughly
11.4% swing
in either direction after earnings. At the $455 strike near Dell's recent share price, the call was priced around

That volatility reflects the stakes surrounding Dell's AI infrastructure business. Investors increasingly view the company as a beneficiary of spending on high-performance servers and data-center capacity, meaning AI-related demand and profitability could matter more than headline PC results.
Investor Takeaway
Dell investors should focus on whether AI-server growth can keep pace with the expectations now embedded in both the stock and options market.
Key metrics include
AI server orders, backlog, infrastructure revenue growth and margins
, particularly whether rapid revenue expansion is translating into stronger profitability.
With Dell shares up roughly
266% this year

, an earnings beat alone may not be enough. Strong forward guidance and evidence that AI demand remains durable could extend the rally, while slowing orders, weaker margins or cautious guidance could make the options market's implied downside increasingly relevant.

title: Dell Stock Flashes Major Last-Minute Signal Before Earnings
